infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Macaroonie Office uses the camera to scan barcodes and take photos for Pepper.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Macaroonie Office listens only while you hold the microphone, or after you tap it until you tap again.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Macaroonie Office turns what you say to Pepper into text.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Macaroonie Office lets you pick a photo, such as an invoice or a delivery note, to keep for review or show Pepper.
